above_basis: Micronesian is a subgroup of Oceanic (Bender et al. 2003; Lynch, Ross and Crowley 2002), Oceanic of Malayo-Polynesian, Malayo-Polynesian of Austronesian. The MCD's Pre-Proto-Micronesian and Pre-Proto-Oceanic are stages just above the proto-language of their names. Whether Micronesian belongs to Eastern Oceanic is disputed, so Proto-Eastern Oceanic is not placed above Proto-Micronesian.

protoeasternoceanic.basis: An Oceanic subgroup; not above Proto-Micronesian (see above_basis).

protokimbe.basis: An Oceanic (Meso-Melanesian) group; no glottocode in the release.

protowesternmalayopolynesian.basis: A Malayo-Polynesian grouping, as in the ACD's tree; no glottocode in the release.

uraustronesisch.basis: Dempwolff's reconstructions in his notation, cited as comparanda; not a level of the tree.
